The '''Senate Dispensation Committee''' was a [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] committee that was [[Chairman/Legends|chaired]] by [[Canny Mandary Bertar]], the [[Senator/Legends|senator]] for the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]]. The committee met on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and was responsible for overseeing the issue of government grants to freelancers, in the form of shipping licences, permits to carry out [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|hunting]] and the loan of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]] for use on important missions.<ref name="CCW" />
